احتقبنا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَقَبْنَا (iḥtaqabnā) /iħ.ta.qab.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# اُحْتُقِبْنَا (uḥtuqibnā) /uħ.tu.qib.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
